label: So
note: Ancient Japanese dairy product of the 7th–10th centuries, made by boiling milk down to a solid; the picture shows a modern reconstruction

about.text: A dairy product made in Japan from the 7th to the 10th century by boiling milk down to a solid; it was paid to the court as tribute, used as medicine and offered to the gods, and daigo was made by processing it further.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Made by the Tennyakuryo office of the Ministry of Imperial Household; known site Ajifu in Settsu (now Higashiyodogawa, Osaka)
Historians note no culturing step is recorded; the exact method is not preserved, and the revival recipe of 2020 is a reconstruction
